refunds.title: Refund Policy
refunds.details: CampusConnect does not define a universal refund period in this demo knowledge base. Refund eligibility depends on the relevant service and transaction. A support ticket is required for an individual refund inquiry.

payments.title: Payment Issues
payments.details: If a payment is deducted but an application remains unpaid, retain the transaction reference and confirmation. Support must review the transaction before a resolution can be promised.

applications.title: College Applications
applications.details: Admission requirements, application fees, and deadlines vary by institution. Students should verify current details with the institution's official website.

accounts.title: Account Access
accounts.details: Users can try the Forgot Password flow to regain account access. Issues that remain unresolved should be sent to support.
